Get the dictionary schema for entities of a project

params.name: program
params.description: The program to which the submitter belongs and in which the entities will be created. The `program` is the human-readable name, e.g. TCGA.

params.name: project
params.description: The project to which the submitter belongs and in which the entities will be created. The `project` is the human-readable code, e.g. BRCA.

items.docs: Return links to the project level JSON schema definitions.

info.name: Get templates for all entity types of a project

params.name: program
params.description: The program to which the submitter belongs and in which the entities will be created. The `program` is the human-readable name, e.g. TCGA.

params.name: project
params.description: The project to which the submitter belongs and in which the entities will be created. The `project` is the human-readable code, e.g. BRCA.

params.name: format
params.description: output format, ``csv`` or ``tsv``, default is tsv

params.name: categories
params.description: list of entities' categories to include in the template

params.name: exclude
params.description: list of entities' categories to exclude from the template

items.docs: Get templates for all entity types. In the template, Links are represented as {link_type}.{link_unique_key} for one_to_one  and many_to_one relationships. For many_to_many relationships, they are represented as {link_type}.{link_unique_key}#1 to infer user the multiplicity

info.name: Get a template for an entity type of a project

params.name: program
params.description: The program to which the submitter belongs and in which the entities will be created. The `program` is the human-readable name, e.g. TCGA.

params.name: project
params.description: The project to which the submitter belongs and in which the entities will be created. The `project` is the human-readable code, e.g. BRCA.

params.name: format
params.description: output format, ``csv`` or ``tsv``, default is tsv

items.docs: Return TSV template of an entity type. In the template, links are represented as {link_type}.{link_unique_key} for one_to_one and many_to_one relationships. For many_to_many relationships, they are represented as {link_type}.{link_unique_key}#1 to infer user the multiplicity.
